LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays a configurable informational, warning, or error alert banner.

property.name: type
property.label: Type
property.description: Controls the banner colors and default icon.

property.name: icon
property.label: Icon
property.description: Enter an SLDS icon such as user, warning, error, or utility:announcement. Leave blank to use the selected type's default.

property.name: text
property.label: Banner Text
property.description: Enter the banner message. Supported HTML links and formatting are sanitized before display.
